raw_tokens.value: You gain a +%1 bonus on Knowledge (Geography), Perception, Stealth, and Survival checks, Initiative checks and cannot be tracked in plains terrain|FavoredTerrainPlains

You gain a +%1 bonus on Knowledge (Geography), Perception, Stealth, and Survival checks when using these skills in plains terrain. Likewise, you get a +%1 bonus on initiative checks when in this terrain. If you desire, you leave no trail in this terrain and cannot be tracked.|FavoredTerrainPlains
